  (hS : IsCompact S) :
  ∃ C,
    0 < C ∧
      ∀ (b : HeckeAdeles K → ℂ),
        Function.support b ⊆ S →
          (∀ (z : HeckeIdeles K), b ↑z ≠ 0 → ∀ (v : FinitePlace K), ‖(↑z).2 v.maximalIdeal‖ ≤ 1) →
            ∀ (g y : HeckeIdeles K),
              max C (genuineIdeleModulus K g * C) < genuineIdeleModulus K y → theta K (compensatedSeed K g b) y = 0
